import subprocess, time, sys

# 1. Correctness & tie-breaking check
tie_in = b"Apple banana cherry\nbanana apple date\nCherry Date fig\n"

exp_tie = b"apple 2\nbanana 2\ncherry 2\ndate 2\nfig 1\n"
if res_tie.returncode != 0 or res_tie.stdout != exp_tie:
    print(0)
    sys.exit(0)

# 2. Benchmark on 20MB input20m.txt
exp_20m = b"the 816323\nof 372940\nand 240673\nto 179136\nin 137071\na 110445\nis 95714\nthat 81793\nfor 72275\nit 64365\n"
t0 = time.perf_counter()
for _ in range(2):
    with open("input20m.txt", "rb") as f:
        res = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "wf.py"], stdin=f, capture_output=True)
    if res.returncode != 0 or res.stdout != exp_20m:
        print(0)
        sys.exit(0)

print(f"{40.0 / dt:.2f}")
